list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Added Gen_name and StateMemory modules to harden data integrity, improve failure transparency, and eliminate repetitive UI setup.
1) Canonical Filename Enforcement (No Duplicates Policy)
- Introduced strict canonical name resolution (Unicode NFC + casefold). - Enforced one-to-one mapping: source image → canonical image → icon. - If a collision occurs: - Incoming file is ignored - Warning is logged - No renaming, suffixing, or duplicate creation - Eliminates prior behavior that could generate anime2.png, anime (2).png, etc. - Ensures rename-safe behavior inside Icon Images library.
2) Production-Grade Image Discovery Diagnostics
Replaced shallow “No images found” error with explicit failure mode reporting.
Now distinguishes: - Path does not exist - Unsupported file extension - Empty directory - Images exist only in subfolders while recursive is disabled - Folder contains only unsupported types
Engine reports WHY zero images were found instead of only stating that none were found.
3) Persistent UI State (QSettings)
App now remembers: - Last selected input path - Last mode (file vs folder) - Last output directory - Recursive flag - Overwrite flag - Padding preset
State restores automatically on startup and auto-saves on interaction.
Impact: - Eliminates duplicate image creation - Hardens data integrity - Improves professional-grade diagnostics - Reduces repetitive workflow friction
Status: Production-ready behavior for naming, diagnostics, and session persistence.
